name: Lucky Streak
description: For this question, a correct answer earns a random bonus on top of the normal value.

name: Golden Answer
description: This question is worth substantially more if you get it right. The bonus is randomized.

name: Small Fortune
description: A correct answer receives a modest extra payout this turn.

name: Jackpot Question
description: The question's value is multiplied by a random jackpot multiplier if answered correctly.

name: Double Down
description: Get this question right and its value is doubled. A wrong answer carries the normal consequences for the question.

name: Supercharge
description: The correct-answer payout is randomly increased by 25% to 75%.

name: Bonus Round
description: A correct response earns an additional randomized bonus, regardless of the question's category or value.

name: Hot Seat
description: The current question becomes a high-pressure opportunity: a correct answer earns 40% to 60% more.

name: Double or Bust
description: This question pays double when answered correctly. The normal wrong-answer rules still apply.

name: Extra Credit
description: A correct answer receives a randomized extra-credit payout.

name: Lucky Break
description: The game gives the answering team a temporary 20% to 40% increase on a correct response.

name: Big Break
description: One correct answer can produce a major payout, with the multiplier determined at random.

name: Cash In
description: Answer correctly to collect a randomized cash bonus in addition to the question's normal value.

name: Double Payout
description: The current question pays twice its listed value when answered correctly.

name: Prize Surge
description: The payout for a correct answer is boosted by a random 50% to 90%.

name: Wager
description: Choose a wager before answering. The wager is added to a correct payout or lost on an incorrect answer.
